title: polypodium hyperboreum
intro: Polypodium hyperboreum, commonly known as Northern Maidenhair Fern, is a type of plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional herbal medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Polypodium hyperboreum include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects.
